answer: Forked credentials stay cheap when one bond is photocopied onto every alias. This gate drives a copper stake into a public trellis bay that braces only one live key. The key walks three atlas meridians 83 minutes apart. At meridian i a disjoint surveyor waits 21 minutes for a live bearing, then posts bearing_i = blake2b(bay||stake||surveyor_pk||height||i). Stake locks 21 POA for 9 epochs; each bearing costs 0.33 POA. Auditors replay occupancy, disjointness, and spacing. A shared bay, recycled surveyor, or pre-posted bearing cuts 26 percent to that surveyor and shelves the key 11 epochs.
